statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-86414: an HTTP proxy can make libcurl send the origin server's credentials (a Basic password or a Negotiate ticket) to the proxy itself by answering the CONNECT tunnel request with a 401 and a WWW-Authenticate header instead of a 407 and a Proxy-Authenticate header (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-86414.html). It affects the curl tool and libcurl from 7.10.8 to 8.22.0 and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/2956af6c7451029fb12c12f8166dff211f930d52, which stops the CONNECT response handling in lib/cf-h1-proxy.c and lib/http_proxy.c from reading WWW-Authenticate on a 401. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 published in the DHI Alpine main repository as of 2026-11-28 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. Inspected the static libcurl.a in curl-static and libcurl.so.4 in libcurl of every one of these builds, on x86_64 and aarch64. In libcurl.a the proxy tunnel objects (built from cf-h1-proxy.c, plus cf-h2-proxy.c up to 8.20.0 and http_proxy.c from 8.21.0) contain the WWW-Authenticate header name in every build before 8.23.0-r0 and in none of them in 8.23.0-r0 or 8.23.0-r1, while the cf-h1-proxy.c object contains the Proxy-authenticate header name the fixed code still reads in every build. In libcurl.so.4, located with the symbols in curl-dbg, Curl_http_proxy_inspect_tunnel_response compares the response status with 401 in 8.21.0-r0 and 8.22.0-r0 and not in 8.23.0-r0 or 8.23.0-r1. 8.23.0-r0 is the first fixed build. Packages published only in the DHI Alpine security repository, which needs credentials, were not inspected.
